title: SO(3) isotropic rank-4 basis and volumetric/deviatoric projectors
expression_sketch: Most general Cartesian isotropic rank-4 tensor in 3D: T(i,j,k,l) = lam*delta(i,j)*delta(k,l) + mu*delta(i,k)*delta(j,l) + nu*delta(i,l)*delta(j,k).  Symmetrized identity on Sym^2(R^3): I_s(i,j,k,l) = (1/2)*(delta(i,k)*delta(j,l)+delta(i,l)*delta(j,k)).  Volumetric and symmetric-deviatoric projectors: P_vol(i,j,k,l) = (1/3)*delta(i,j)*delta(k,l),  P_dev(i,j,k,l) = I_s(i,j,k,l) - P_vol(i,j,k,l).  Double-contraction identities (sum p,q in {1,2,3}): P_vol(i,j,p,q)*P_vol(p,q,k,l) = P_vol(i,j,k,l), P_dev(i,j,p,q)*P_dev(p,q,k,l) = P_dev(i,j,k,l), P_vol(i,j,p,q)*P_dev(p,q,k,l) = 0, P_vol+P_dev = I_s.  Isotropic Hooke operator on symmetric strains: C(i,j,k,l) = 3*K*P_vol(i,j,k,l) + 2*G*P_dev(i,j,k,l) (equivalently two Lame scalars, nu=mu in T).
latent_structure: Invariant basis of SO(3)-isotropic rank-4 tensors (3 Kronecker generators), then the symmetry-adapted spectral/projector split of Sym^2(R^3) into volumetric (1-dimensional) and traceless-deviatoric (5-dimensional) irreps. Orthogonal idempotents, not index renaming.

function_domains.delta: Kronecker delta on {1,2,3} in an orthonormal Cartesian frame.
function_domains.T: Cartesian rank-4 tensor components, numerically invariant under SO(3).
function_domains.I_s: Fourth-order symmetrizer / identity on symmetric 3x3 matrices.
function_domains.P_vol: Orthogonal projector onto spherical/volumetric tensors (1/3)(tr A) I.
function_domains.P_dev: Orthogonal projector onto symmetric traceless tensors.

nonzero_conditions.statement: dim = 3 is nonzero, so the coefficient 1/3 in P_vol is defined in Q.
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: 3D Cartesian tensor analysis (Jeffreys; DAMTP NST MMII handout 15; LibreTexts C.5)

source_provenance: H. Jeffreys and B. S. Jeffreys, Methods of Mathematical Physics, 3rd ed., §3.03 Isotropic Tensors.
DAMTP NST MMII handout 15, isotropic rank-4 form λ δij δkl + μ δik δjl + ν δil δjk: https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/reh10/lectures/nst-mmii-handout15.pdf

derived_conditions.statement: I_s : I_s = I_s on symmetric arguments because I_s is the identity of Sym^2.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: definition of the symmetric fourth-order identity

derived_conditions.statement: P_vol and P_dev are complementary: P_vol + P_dev = I_s follows by subtracting the two displayed formulae.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

derived_conditions.statement: Elasticity minor symmetries force nu=mu, reducing the 3-dimensional isotropic basis to two Lame generators.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: DAMTP handout 15 elasticity paragraph; conservation of angular momentum (symmetric stress)

public_source: Jeffreys §3.03; DAMTP MMII handout 15; LibreTexts C.5; deal.II StandardTensors
why_not_cse_lgg: The expanded 81-component array of an isotropic 4-tensor has many repeated 0/λ/μ/ν entries; CSE merges copies but does not invent the three Kronecker generators or the projector algebra. LGG cannot change representation from components to an SO(3)-invariant basis.
proposer_leak_risk: Hide P_vol, P_dev, Lamé, hydrostatic, Kelvin spectral decomposition. Do not print the three-term Kronecker ansatz in proposer context.
notes: Purely algebraic in Kronecker symbols. No metric signature, no analysis. K,G are free scalars; positivity of bulk/shear moduli is physical folklore and is not used for the projector identities.
